text: Steenbarger, minervini: my one trigger is h1_close_above:bar_high on H1, after a pull-in to structure_shift_ref. close_above:high_52w_close buys only once price has left the reaction, the chase C15 forbids. W 9>21 HH/HL holds the trend; D red bar, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 2.73, H1 below EMA9 at pos_in_day_range_pct 39.5 is the corrective wave C3 joins at the test (C7), on a sign-of-strength bar (C12). Wrong on a daily close below structure_shift_ref or a bearish CHoCH. Nothing new moved me; my objection clears when the ticket prints that trigger.
